findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: tinplate_consent_tokens, tinplate_consent_tokens_verify · Private data: tinplate_pii_redactor, tinplate_pii_redactor_restore, tinplate_prompt_cache_budgeter, tinplate_content_provenance, tinplate_html_to_markdown, tinplate_secret_scanner, tinplate_secret_scanner_restore, tinplate_ssrf_firewall, tinplate_email_dns_generator, tinplate_consent_tokens, tinplate_consent_tokens_verify, tinplate_hu_business_validator, tinplate_robots_llms_analyzer, tinplate_semver_lockfile_judge, tinplate_jwt_jwk_inspector, tinplate_rag_chunker · Public sink: tinplate_pii_redactor, tinplate_pii_redactor_restore, tinplate_prompt_guard, tinplate_mcp_manifest_linter, tinplate_tool_call_validator, tinplate_hallucination_diff, tinplate_prompt_cache_budgeter, tinplate_agent_action_receipts, tinplate_agent_action_receipts_verify, tinplate_content_provenance, tinplate_json_heal, tinplate_html_to_markdown, tinplate_locale_value_parser, tinplate_secret_scanner, tinplate_secret_scanner_restore, tinplate_ssrf_firewall, tinplate_security_headers, tinplate_webhook_verify, tinplate_email_dns, tinplate_email_dns_generator, tinplate_consent_tokens, tinplate_consent_tokens_verify, tinplate_eu_vat_iban, tinplate_eu_vat_iban_vat, tinplate_invoice_validator, tinplate_hu_business_validator, tinplate_workday_holiday, tinplate_workday_holiday_add, tinplate_workday_holiday_is_workday, tinplate_signup_fraud, tinplate_cron_explainer, tinplate_schema_diff, tinplate_ua_bot_parser, tinplate_url_normalizer, tinplate_ics_sanitizer, tinplate_robots_llms_analyzer, tinplate_semver_lockfile_judge, tinplate_llm_output_guard, tinplate_command_sql_guard, tinplate_eu_id_validator, tinplate_jwt_jwk_inspector, tinplate_rag_chunker, tinplate_regex_safety, tinplate_llm_messages_guard, tinplate_tabular_rag_cleaner, tinplate_peppol_ubl_invoice, tinplate_eu_vat_calculator, tinplate_sanctions_screener, tinplate_agent_code_guard · Destructive: tinplate_llm_output_guard.
